Downtown & Waterfront.name: Downtown & Waterfront
Downtown & Waterfront.description: Central business district along the Ohio River waterfront with the KFC Yum! Center and riverfront redevelopment driving mixed-use permits.

NuLu (East Market District).name: NuLu (East Market District)
NuLu (East Market District).description: East Market Street gallery-and-boutique corridor converting industrial stock to hospitality and residential above retail.

Phoenix Hill & Shelby Street.name: Phoenix Hill & Shelby Street
Phoenix Hill & Shelby Street.description: Hill-edge infill between downtown and the Highlands with small-lot townhome and adaptive-reuse activity.

Bardstown Road Highlands.name: Bardstown Road Highlands
Bardstown Road Highlands.description: The commercial spine of the Highlands — independent retail, music venues, and dense mid-rise multifamily.

GermanTown & Paristown.name: GermanTown & Paristown
GermanTown & Paristown.description: Post-industrial bungalow grid rehabbing into breweries, maker spaces, and infill townhomes.

Douglass Loop.name: Douglass Loop
Douglass Loop.description: South Highlands village node with renovation-led permitting and strict neighborhood overlay review.

Clifton & Frankfort Ave.name: Clifton & Frankfort Ave
Clifton & Frankfort Ave.description: Walkable neighborhood commercial corridor with mixed-use infill and hospitality conversions.

Crescent Hill.name: Crescent Hill
Crescent Hill.description: Streetcar-era bungalow district around the reservoir with renovation-heavy permits.

Bonnycastle.name: Bonnycastle
Bonnycastle.description: Established residential pocket between the Highlands and Crescent Hill with teardown/rebuild pressure.

Old Louisville.name: Old Louisville
Old Louisville.description: Nationally significant Victorian residential district with historic-preservation overlay permitting.

Shelby Park.name: Shelby Park
Shelby Park.description: South-of-downtown park neighborhood undergoing cafe-and-townhome infill.

Smoketown.name: Smoketown
Smoketown.description: Historic Black neighborhood near downtown with early-stage redevelopment and new-construction permits.

St. Matthews.name: St. Matthews
St. Matthews.description: Established inner-suburb retail node with mall-adjacent mixed-use and multifamily redevelopment.

Eastpoint & Lyndon.name: Eastpoint & Lyndon
Eastpoint & Lyndon.description: Eastern Jefferson County edge with office-to-residential conversions and suburban infill.

Hurstbourne.name: Hurstbourne
Hurstbourne.description: I-64 corridor office park and hotel district with selective redevelopment pressure.

Portland.name: Portland
Portland.description: River-front historic neighborhood with early-stage industrial-to-residential conversion and flood-recovery investment.

Shawnee & Chickasaw.name: Shawnee & Chickasaw
Shawnee & Chickasaw.description: Western Louisville park-side neighborhoods with renovation-led permits and affordability overlays.

Russell.name: Russell
Russell.description: Historic West End neighborhood with new-construction and rehab permitting near the Portland renewal zone.
